chyloderma.d: swelling of the scrotum resulting from chronic lymphatic obstruction

chylaceous.d: consisting of chyle or having the properties of chyle

chymosin.d: an enzyme that occurs in gastric juice; causes milk to coagulate

chylomicron.d: a microscopic particle of triglycerides produced in the intestines during digestion; in the bloodstream they release their fatty acids into the blood

chyme.d: a semiliquid mass of partially digested food that passes from the stomach through the pyloric sphincter into the duodenum

chyle.d: a milky fluid consisting of lymph and emulsified fats; formed in the small intestine during digestion of ingested fats

chylous.d: consisting of chyle or having the properties of chyle
